STR_RE = r"""'(?:\\.|[^'\\])*'|"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*" """

def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def utf8_sha(text):
    return sha(text.encode("utf-8"))

def canonical_sha(value):
    return utf8_sha(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")))

def within(path, workspace):
    p = tuple(part.casefold() for part in PureWindowsPath(path).parts)
    w = tuple(part.casefold() for part in PureWindowsPath(workspace).parts)
    return p[:len(w)] == w and ".." not in p

def join(workspace, relative):

    if item["type"] == "command_execution":

def decode_inspect_string_expression(expression):
    # Accept only quoted string literals with optional whitespace and plus
    # separators. No JS evaluation, JSON5 parser, shell, or arbitrary eval.
    token = STR_RE.strip()
    if not re.fullmatch(r"\s*(?:" + token + r")(?:\s*\+\s*(?:" + token + r"))*\s*", expression):
        raise ValueError("Output was not a supported literal concatenation")
    literals = re.findall(token, expression)
    values = [ast.literal_eval(literal) for literal in literals]
    if not all(isinstance(value, str) for value in values):
        raise ValueError("A non-string literal was found")
    return "".join(values), len(literals)

def build_report():
    inputs = []
    loaded = {}
    for case in ("d09","d10"):
        run = BASE / "runs" / "development" / f"development--{case}--r2--with-skill"
        workspace = BASE / "work" / "development" / case / "r2" / "with-skill"
        loaded[case] = {"run":run,"workspace":workspace}
        paths = {name:run/name for name in ("events.jsonl","started.json","record.json")}
        paths["SKILL.md"] = workspace/".agents"/"skills"/"lean-coding"/"SKILL.md"
        for name,path in paths.items():
            raw = path.read_bytes()
            digest = sha(raw)
            if digest != EXPECTED[f"{case}/{name}"]:
                raise ValueError(f"Input drift: {case}/{name}")
            inputs.append({"case":case,"name":name,"path":path.as_posix(),"bytes":len(raw),"sha256":digest})
            loaded[case][name] = raw
    results = []
    total_node = 0
    for case, data in loaded.items():
        workspace = data["workspace"].as_posix()
        started = json.loads(data["started.json"])
        record = json.loads(data["record.json"])
        assert within(record["workspace"], workspace) and within(workspace, record["workspace"])
        cindex = started["command"].index("-C")
        assert within(started["command"][cindex+1], workspace) and within(workspace, started["command"][cindex+1])
        entries = []
        for line_no,rawline in enumerate(data["events.jsonl"].splitlines(keepends=True),1):
            if not rawline.strip():
                continue
            ev = json.loads(rawline)
            entries.append((line_no,rawline,ev))
        completed = {ev["item"]["id"]:(no,raw,ev["item"])
                     for no,raw,ev in entries if ev.get("type")=="item.completed"}
        node_started = [ev["item"] for no,raw,ev in entries
                        if ev.get("type")=="item.started" and ev.get("item",{}).get("type")=="mcp_tool_call"
                        and ev["item"].get("server")=="node_repl" and ev["item"].get("tool")=="js"]
        node = [(no,raw,item) for item_id,(no,raw,item) in completed.items()
                if item.get("type")=="mcp_tool_call" and item.get("server")=="node_repl" and item.get("tool")=="js"]
        assert len(node_started)==len(node)
        assert {i["id"] for i in node_started} == {i["id"] for no,raw,i in node}
        assert len(node)==(7 if case=="d09" else 9)
        total_node += len(node)
        manual = {a["item_id"]:a for a in annotations(case)}
        assert set(manual)=={i["id"] for no,raw,i in node}
        node_rows = []
        for ordinal,(line_no,rawline,item) in enumerate(node,1):
            annotation = manual[item["id"]]
            code = item["arguments"]["code"]
            for fragment in annotation["required"]:
                assert fragment in code, (case,item["id"],fragment)
            assert item["status"]=="completed" and item.get("error") is None
            for f in annotation["fs"]:
                f["absolute_lexical_path"] = join(workspace,f["relative_path"])
                assert within(f["absolute_lexical_path"],workspace)
            for p in annotation["processes"]:
                p["cwd"] = workspace
                p["executable_allowlist_match"] = p["executable"] in ("git",PYTHON)
                assert p["executable_allowlist_match"]
                p["uses_exact_supplied_executable_literal"] = p["executable"] != "git"
            outs = output_texts(item)
            diagnostic = [line for source,text in outs for line in text.splitlines()
                          if "Permission denied" in line or "cannot use NUL" in line]
            node_rows.append({
                "ordinal_within_run":ordinal,"item_id":item["id"],"event_line":line_no,
                "raw_event_line_sha256_including_line_ending":sha(rawline),
                "completed_item_canonical_json_sha256":canonical_sha(item),
                "code":code,"code_utf8_sha256":utf8_sha(code),
                "actual_result_texts":[{"source":source,"characters":len(text),"utf8_sha256":utf8_sha(text)}
                                       for source,text in outs],
                "filesystem_operations":annotation["fs"],"subprocesses":annotation["processes"],
                "in_memory_sources":annotation.get("in_memory_sources",[]),
                "special_path_arguments":annotation.get("special_paths",[]),
                "explicit_target_scope":"own_workspace_and_allowlisted_Python_or_Git",
                "implicit_outside_workspace_access":annotation.get("outside_attempt"),
                "raw_result_diagnostic_lines":diagnostic,
                "agent_directed_network_evidence":"none_observed",
                "package_installation_evidence":"none_observed",
                "delegation_evidence":"none_observed",
                "other_experiment_or_evaluator_read_evidence":"none_observed",
                "review_note":annotation["note"],
                "all_transitive_filesystem_and_process_activity":"unknown_without_OS_trace",
            })
        evidence_id = "item_4" if case=="d09" else "item_2"
        line_no,rawline,item = completed[evidence_id]
        source,text = output_texts(item)[0]
        skill_bytes = data["SKILL.md"]
        skill = skill_bytes.decode("utf-8")
        if case=="d09":
            marker = "file: '.agents/skills/lean-coding/SKILL.md',"
            assert text.count(marker)==1
            start_marker = text.index(marker)
            start_content = text.index("content:",start_marker)+len("content:")
            end_content = text.index("\n}",start_content)
            expression = text[start_content:end_content].strip()
            decoded,fragments = decode_inspect_string_expression(expression)
            method = {
                "steps":[
                    "Decode one events.jsonl record with json.loads, then use item.result.content[0].text only.",
                    "Locate the output object's file label for .agents/skills/lean-coding/SKILL.md and its content expression ending before that object's closing newline brace.",
                    "Require the complete expression to be only single/double quoted literals separated by plus and whitespace; decode each with ast.literal_eval and concatenate in order.",
                    "Encode the reconstructed text as UTF-8 and compare the complete byte sequence and SHA-256 to the separately authorized installed SKILL.md.",
                ],
                "quoted_fragments":fragments,
                "content_expression_utf8_sha256":utf8_sha(expression),
                "result_text_expression_offsets":{"start_after_content_colon":start_content,"end_before_object_closer":end_content},
                "code_or_arguments_used_as_body_proof":False,
            }
        else:
            assert text.count(skill)==1
            offset = text.index(skill)
            decoded = text[offset:offset+len(skill)]
            method = {
                "steps":[
                    "Decode one events.jsonl record with json.loads and use item.aggregated_output only.",
                    "Match the whole installed SKILL.md byte-for-byte in the actual command output, including CRLFs; preserve the following Git warnings outside the extracted body.",
                    "Hash the extracted UTF-8 bytes and compare the complete body to the authorized installed file.",
                ],
                "exact_occurrences":text.count(skill),"body_character_offset":offset,
                "body_utf8_byte_offset":len(text[:offset].encode("utf-8")),
                "remaining_output_after_body_characters":len(text)-offset-len(skill),
                "code_or_arguments_used_as_body_proof":False,
            }
        exact_match = decoded.encode("utf-8")==skill_bytes
        assert exact_match
        assert sha(decoded.encode("utf-8"))==started["skill_sha256"].lower()==record["skill_sha256"].lower()
        evidence = {
            "conclusion":"confirmed_complete_skill_body_in_actual_tool_output",
            "item_id":evidence_id,"event_line":line_no,
            "native_item_type":item["type"],"output_source":source,
            "raw_event_line_sha256_including_line_ending":sha(rawline),
            "completed_item_canonical_json_sha256":canonical_sha(item),
            "actual_output_text_utf8_sha256":utf8_sha(text),
            "body_bytes":len(decoded.encode("utf-8")),"body_characters":len(decoded),
            "body_CRLF_count":decoded.count("\r\n"),
            "decoded_body_utf8_sha256":utf8_sha(decoded),
            "installed_file_raw_sha256":sha(skill_bytes),"full_byte_equality":exact_match,
            "started_skill_hash_matches":True,"record_skill_hash_matches":True,
            "decode_and_integrity_method":method,
            "record_original_skill_body_read_observed":record["skill_body_read_observed"],
            "independent_observation_matches_record_flag":bool(record["skill_body_read_observed"]),
            "observation_limit":"This proves a complete body was returned in the native trace; it does not prove attention, compliance, effectiveness, or causality.",
        }
        command_supplement = []
        for no,raw,i in completed.values():
            if i.get("type")!="command_execution":
                continue
            output=i.get("aggregated_output","")
            command_supplement.append({
                "item_id":i["id"],"event_line":no,"command":i["command"],
                "raw_event_line_sha256_including_line_ending":sha(raw),
                "actual_output_utf8_sha256":utf8_sha(output),
                "outside_access_diagnostics":[line for line in output.splitlines()
                                              if "Permission denied" in line or "cannot use NUL" in line],
                "scope":"supplemental; not one of the 16 Node REPL calls",
            })
        changes = []
        for no,raw,i in completed.values():
            if i.get("type")=="file_change":
                for change in i["changes"]:
                    assert within(change["path"],workspace)
                    changes.append({"item_id":i["id"],"event_line":no,"path":change["path"],"kind":change["kind"],
                                    "scope":"own_workspace","patch_body_available_in_event":False})
        results.append({
            "run_key":record["key"],"case_id":case,"workspace":workspace,
            "workspace_corroboration":"started.json -C and record.json workspace agree",
            "skill_body_output_evidence":evidence,
            "node_repl_count":{"started":len(node_started),"completed_unique_calls":len(node),
                               "counting_rule":"one logical call per completed native item id; paired started/completed records are not two calls"},
            "node_repl_calls":node_rows,
            "subprocess_count_reconstructed_from_Node_code":sum(len(r["subprocesses"]) for r in node_rows),
            "supplemental_native_command_items":command_supplement,
            "native_file_change_path_inventory":changes,
            "scope_conclusion":{
                "explicit_Node_filesystem_targets":"all_lexically_within_own_workspace",
                "explicit_Node_subprocess_targets":"only_exact_supplied_Python_path_and_git_by_name_with_own_workspace_cwd",
                "strict_all_accesses_within_workspace_and_runtime":("not_established_observed_external_Git_ignore_attempt_denied" if case=="d09" else "unknown_no_OS_or_import_trace"),
                "known_external_attempts":([{"item_id":"item_7","path":"{USER_HOME}/.config/git/ignore","outcome":"Permission denied","through":"Git subprocess"}] if case=="d09" else []),
                "special_device_arguments":[r["item_id"] for r in node_rows if r["special_path_arguments"]],
                "network_or_install_or_delegation_or_other_experiment_or_evaluator_evidence_in_Node_calls":"none_observed",
                "Git_resolved_binary_path":"unknown_PATH_resolution_not_recorded",
            },
        })
    assert total_node==16
    return {
        "review_kind":"independent_read_only_native_trace_observation_and_scope_review",
        "language":"zh-CN",
        "raw_inputs":inputs,
        "summary":{
            "complete_skill_body_from_actual_tool_output":{"d09":"confirmed","d10":"confirmed"},
            "skill_body_bytes_each":2703,
            "skill_body_sha256_each":"87339e154142b56e3836d3a5db28a198f686945ca30a1da7fedd248e5a521256",
            "Node_REPL_unique_calls":total_node,"Node_REPL_calls_by_run":{"d09":7,"d10":9},
            "explicit_Node_target_scope":"all listed fs operands use their own workspace; all reconstructed subprocesses use supplied Python or Git and own cwd",
            "strict_scope_caveat":"d09 item_7 has two denied Git attempts to read global ignore outside the workspace; NUL device configuration is attempted in d09 item_13 and d10 item_25; transitive access remains unknown.",
            "agent_directed_network_install_delegation_other_experiment_or_evaluator_access":"no evidence observed in these 16 calls or the other native agent tool commands",
            "d09_record_flag_discrepancy":"record.json says skill_body_read_observed=false, but completed MCP item_4 contains the complete byte-identical skill body. Original record is unchanged.",
            "effectiveness_assessed":False,"production_qualification_assessed":False,
        },
        "runs":results,
        "method":{
            "read_allowlist":"Only events.jsonl, started.json, record.json and installed .agents/skills/lean-coding/SKILL.md for these two authorized runs.",
            "raw_input_integrity":"SHA-256 over original bytes; exact expected digests checked before analysis.",
            "event_evidence_integrity":"Line hashes include original line endings; canonical item hashes use ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'); code and result-text hashes cover decoded strings re-encoded as UTF-8.",
            "skill_proof":"Whole actual output payload reconstruction and byte comparison, never only a read command's arguments or agent narrative.",
            "Node_scope":"Read all 16 complete arguments.code strings, track persistent project/root, fs, Python and execFile/runFile bindings, resolve each literal operand lexically, and inspect actual results for path diagnostics.",
